name: Parker Jones
story: Parker Jones worked in Prime/Eagle sales and implementation during the later-1980s expansion of Esri GIS in New Zealand. He had a substantial commercial role; the record does not support assigning the introduction of GIS in New Zealand to one person.
A Royal Society Wellington Branch biography describes Parker Jones’s role in selecting, importing, selling and supporting software, including Esri GIS.

contentSections.title: Documented contribution in 2019
paragraphs: Parker Jones’s PLACE19 biography records NZ GIS in Conservation supporting more than seventy conservation and iwi groups with over 140 skilled GIS volunteers by 2019. His presentation concerned software access, mentoring, training and conservation projects delivered at no cost to participating groups. These are the programme’s historical figures.
